commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Vitinha (PSG) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort only whistles over the crossbar.
90+7' Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+5' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+5' Bradley Barcola (PSG) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch.
90+5' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Bradley Barcola (PSG). Free kick. Lorient will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+5' The linesman signals that Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+4' Igor Silva (Lorient) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+4' Igor Silva (Lorient) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sambou Soumano (Lorient) comes onto the pitch so that Noah Cadiou can be given a rest.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

89' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Yvon Mvogo is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
87' Arthur Avom (Lorient) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
86' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
85' Vitinha (PSG) sends a long ball in, but Yvon Mvogo comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
82' Good movement by Nuno Mendes (PSG), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
81' Good chance! Theo Le Bris (Lorient) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
81' A cross from Theo Le Bris (Lorient) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
80' Dangerous play by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Nuno Mendes (PSG) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Yvon Mvogo is equal to it and makes an easy save.
78' What an opportunity! Arthur Avom (Lorient) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
77' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
77' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Warren Zaire-Emery and he is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
77' Substitution. Joel Mvuka Mugisha will be replaced by Theo Le Bris (Lorient).
76' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
74' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

74' PSG are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
72' Nuno Mendes (PSG) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

72' Bradley Barcola (PSG) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Yvon Mvogo makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom right corner. PSG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
69' Dermane Karim will be replaced by Arthur Avom (Lorient).
69' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed Bamba.
68' Olivier Pantaloni decides to make a substitution. Pablo Pagis will be replaced by Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient).
68' Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
65' Vitinha (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Desire Doue (PSG) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Bradley Barcola.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ousmane Dembele departs the field of play to be replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
61' Looks like Desire Doue (PSG) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
61' Desire Doue (PSG) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Now PSG have a corner.
60' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
58' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
58' Vitinha (PSG) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Yvon Mvogo gets down to his right to keep it out.
57' Nuno Mendes (PSG) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
54' Vitinha (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Igor Silva (Lorient) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 1:1.
51' A pass from Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is intercepted by Lucas Chevalier and the move breaks down.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Nuno Mendes has a shot blocked, but the ball falls to Nuno Mendes (PSG), who finds some space inside the box and buries the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) comes off for Vitinha.
46' Half-time substitution. Luis Enrique decided to make a change. Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) is replaced by Joao Neves.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The resulting corner, taken by Ousmane Dembele (PSG), comes to nothing.
44' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.

43' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Yvon Mvogo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
43' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Desire Doue (PSG) commits a foul after dangerous play.
42' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
40' Lorient produce a short pass from the free kick.
40' Nuno Mendes (PSG) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Lorient are awarded a free kick.
39' A pass by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' Nuno Mendes (PSG) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Willy Delajod stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
37' Nuno Mendes (PSG) with a great individual effort and attempt from long range. The shot went towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out.

33' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Lucas Chevalier pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
32' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
31' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
31' It looks like Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) saw red with that tackle. Willy Delajod won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lorient.
31' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Senny Mayulu (PSG). The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
30' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is able to continue to play.
27' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
26' Senny Mayulu (PSG) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
25' Ball possession – 19:81.
24' Nuno Mendes (PSG) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.

23' Poor challenge! Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Willy Delajod blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Nuno Mendes (PSG) is going to have a crack himself.
19' Fine play by Dermane Karim (Lorient) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
17' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
14' The ball is cleared after Desire Doue (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Flag up against Mohamed Bamba (Lorient). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
11' A pass by Marquinhos (PSG) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
8' Willy Delajod blows the whistle, Dermane Karim (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. A free kick to PSG.
5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
4' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is flagged for offside.
3' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
1' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
PSG will kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
